hub.description: One assembler ranks every item that steers an agent in this workspace.

governance.absentTitle: {repository} has no {path}. A missing file means team.
governance.invalidTitle: {path} on {repository} names no mode Oxagen knows, so every Context PR open and merge is refused.
governance.unboundTitle: No main repository is bound, so no governance.toml is read.
governance.unreadTitle: The governance mode could not be read: {code}.
governance.title: Governance mode for {workspace}
governance.subtitle: {path} on {repository}

solo.summary: The author may merge their own.
solo.hint: For a repository nobody else reviews.

team.hint: The mode a missing governance.toml means.

regulated.summary: A named approver from a role must approve, and the promotion ledger is hash-chained.
regulated.hint: The author of a record cannot approve it.

governance.tomlHeader:
# {path}: read on the production branch when a pull request is
# opened and again when it is merged. A missing file means team.
governance.note: The mode is read off the file when a pull request is opened and again when it is merged, so raising it takes effect on everything already in flight.
governance.proposed: Pull request opened on {repository}: {path} sets mode = {mode}. It takes effect on merge for everything already in flight; nothing else in Oxagen writes that file.
governance.applied: {path} on {branch} of {repository} now sets mode = {mode}. It is in force now. Under solo the change skips review.
governance.unchanged: Governance mode is already {mode}; nothing to change.

failure.denied: Your roles here do not include set_governance_mode. An org Owner or Admin, or a workspace Owner or Admin, changes the mode. Nothing was changed.
failure.noRepository: This workspace has no steering repository the GitHub App can reach, so there is no governance.toml to change. Check the GitHub connection on Repositories.
failure.refused: The change was refused: {code}. Nothing was changed.
failure.pendingApproval: The change is waiting for approval: {accessRequestId}.
failure.unavailable: The change could not be made: {code}. Nothing was changed.

governance.lowering: Not recorded yet: an org-owner approval and a security event when the mode is lowered. Tracked in #{issue}.

library.grantsNote: items that also compile to a gate
library.lead: The assembler reads these items in this order and picks the ones each run receives.
library.planes: The Library, Assignments, and the Compiler show the text the model reads. Gates shows the calls Oxagen refuses.
library.title: All items
library.compilesTitle: list_records carries no enforcement grant, so whether this record also compiles to a gate is not recorded. Tracked in #{issue}.
library.tokensTitle: list_records carries no token cost for a record. Tracked in #{issue}.
library.scopeTargetTitle: list_records carries no repository for a record, so the repository this record names is not recorded. Tracked in #{issue}.
library.gap: Only records are read into this list today. Instructions, skills, memory, and ontology notes join it when the steering registry (Phase 1) reads every source into one item type, tracked in #{issue}.
library.truncated: This list holds the first {read} of the {total} records in force, in the assembler's order.

empty.title: Nothing steers this workspace yet
empty.body: Published records live in .oxagen/rules/ on {repository}. A record is published when its pull request merges.

error.title: Steering could not be loaded
error.body: Nothing was changed. Runs kept recording while this page was down. Frames are written by the collector on each host, not by Oxagen.
error.incidentNote: Oxagen records no incidents yet. Report the line below to your operator.

denied.title: You cannot see this workspace’s steering
denied.body: Your roles on {org} do not include {permission}. An organization owner can grant it. The grant is a governed action and lands in the audit record with your name on it.
denied.requestNote: Oxagen records no access requests yet. An organization owner grants {permission} on Organization › Roles.

pending.title: Your access to this workspace’s steering is waiting for approval

assignments.what: which agent receives which item, per agent, with its delivery, gates, stable prefix, volatile selection, cuts, and skills. It needs the assembler's registry port (Phase 1).
assignments.lead: An item reaches an agent when its scope matches the run and a hook on the agent's runtime delivers it.
assignments.truncated: Showing the first {read} enrolled agents. The registry holds more.
assignments.panelNote: Each row shows one assembly for the agent's usual prompt. A different prompt changes only the volatile selection.

reaches.repository: Only an agent whose run works in that repository.
reaches.agent: Only the agent named on the item.

assignments.scopeWhat: the scope of instructions, skills, memory, and ontology notes. Only records carry a scope today, so this panel counts records.
assignments.closing: The checks refuse a repository record that allows more than its workspace record.

empty.title: No agent receives steering here
empty.body: Steering reaches an agent through a hook on its runtime. No agent in this workspace is enrolled, so nothing is delivered.

gates.what: the gates that reach this workspace and the gate notice each puts back into steering. The workspace's freshness gates are below.
gates.textBody: Every item compiles to text that the assembler ranks and may cut for budget.
gates.gateBody: An item with an enforcement grant also compiles to a gate that refuses matching calls, even when the index is down.
gates.closing: The assembler puts every gate notice that applies at the start of the stable prefix and keeps all of them. Edit decision rules and kill switches on Tools, and a mandate on its own page.
gates.tiers: What a gate can refuse depends on the tier. For actions routed through Oxagen, the server refuses the call. On the harness tier the four blocking hook events refuse a harness-native call: client-attested and fail-open.
gates.noSwitch: No kill switch is on in this workspace.
gates.truncated: The kill switch read came back at its ceiling, so an older switch that is still on may be missing here. Tools lists every switch.

compiler.what: one assembly for one agent and one prompt, with the manifest of what was cut and why. It needs assembleSteering behind a read contract.

empty.title: Nothing to compile yet
empty.body: No item is published in this workspace, so the assembler has nothing to select from. Publish a record and this tab shows what an agent would receive.

compiler.placeholder: Type what the operator would type
compiler.noAgent: No agent in this workspace is set up for preview.
compiler.hint: The agent's tier and repository are not recorded yet. Tracked in #{issue}.

prefix.title: Stable prefix
prefix.sub: Gate notices first, then must and should items, up to 16 KiB.

volatile.title: Volatile selection
volatile.sub: may and info items ranked against this prompt until the token budget is spent.

skills.title: Skills
skills.sub: The harness loads skill files itself, so only each description line competes for the budget.

compiler.cutsBadge: recorded on a run as a steering.manifest frame
compiler.closing: This page leaves out MCP tool results and the model request the proxy writes on the gateway and contained tiers. A run's Context tab shows that request.

empty.title: Nothing has been recalled yet
empty.body: Memory is what an agent's own runs leave behind. No run in this workspace has written one, so nothing competes from here.

tiles.sourcesNote: {people} written by a person and {others} by an agent or the system
tiles.recalledNote: the recall counter is not recorded yet

memory.lead: Memories come from agents' own runs and compete only in the volatile selection, where a published record overrides them.
memory.forgotten: Forgot {ref}. The assembler stops selecting it. Every run that carried it is untouched.
memory.title: Recalled memory
memory.provenance: {ref} · {source} · {who, select, person {a person wrote it} agent {an agent wrote it} other {the system wrote it}}
memory.tokensTitle: Tokens this memory's line spends in the assembled context
memory.compilerNote: Recall reaches only the in-app agent today, capped at six items.

dialog.subtitle: Recalled memory
dialog.costValue: {count} tokens every time it is selected
dialog.position: Where it sits against the published records is not recorded yet. Tracked in #{issue}.

forget.title: Forget this memory?
forget.body: The assembler stops selecting it, and every agent in scope stops being told it. The runs it was folded from are untouched: every frame stays, and every run that carried it keeps naming the hash it carried.
forget.other: To make a correct memory binding, promote it to a record instead.

ontology.lead: An ontology note under .oxagen/ontology/ on {repository} defines one entity or term and enters the volatile selection as info.
ontology.title: Definitions
ontology.notBacked: Not recorded yet: the notes under .oxagen/ontology/. No read indexes them, so this table draws no rows. Tracked in #{issue}.

today.body: A note is a file under .oxagen/ontology/, published by a merge. The Postgres registry is its index, as it is for records.

later.body: Phase 3 adds the notes to the graph, so a note links the repositories, records, and skills it is about. Delivery never waits for the graph.

notHere.body: Entity extraction and data ingestion, cut by the scope review of 2026-09-14.

instructions.what: the workspace instructions, as items of the one steering list.

skillSource.pending: The source of {skill} opens here when the skill source page ships. The catalog below lists the skill.

failure.denied: You cannot see {section} in this workspace. The roles you hold do not include {permission}. An owner can grant it.
failure.pendingApproval: Your request to see {section} is waiting for approval: {accessRequestId}.
failure.error: {section} could not be loaded: {code}. Nothing was changed.

freshness.title: Steering freshness
freshness.lead: Both switches act on a machine where oxagen steering hooks install has run.
freshness.unbound: No repository is bound, so steering is off for this workspace.
freshness.autoSyncHint: Pulls merged records into the checkout before each prompt unless .oxagen/ has uncommitted work.
freshness.blockStaleRunsHint: Stops a prompt when the checkout lacks a record in force.
freshness.syncPending: Reading a new push or merge from the repository
freshness.syncProblems: {count, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}} in the record files at {commit}

records.title: Published records
records.emptyKind: No record of that kind is in force in this workspace.
records.tokensTitle: Tokens this record's line spends in the signed bundle
records.compilesTitle: Whether this record also compiles to a gate is not recorded yet. Tracked in #{issue}.
records.newTitle: The last merge published this record
records.effectLineTitle: Rendered, cited, and violated counts are not recorded yet. Tracked in #{issue}.
records.truncated: Showing the first {read} of {total} records in force.
records.note: A record with an enforcement grant also compiles to a gate, listed on Gates. The checks allow only {effects} and refuse a repository record that allows more than its workspace record.

disk.title: On disk
disk.failed: The repository tree could not be read: {code}.
disk.unbound: No main repository is bound to this workspace, so there is no tree to read.
disk.note: stella links to this directory, so stella and Oxagen read the same files.

comments.governance: {mode, select, absent {no mode declared} invalid {mode unreadable} other {mode = {mode}}}

injection.title: Injection points
injection.lead: Oxagen delivers steering at these five points and records every delivery.

1.head: SessionStart additional context
1.body: The stable prefix: gate notices, then must and should. Capped at 16 KiB, cached in the signed bundle, works offline.

2.head: UserPromptSubmit additional context
2.body: The volatile selection: may and info, picked for the prompt under a token budget.

3.head: MCP tool results
3.body: What a governed tool call returns, a denial and its reason included.

4.head: Files in the checkout
4.body: Skills, delivered by sync and loaded by the harness's own progressive disclosure.

5.head: The model request itself
5.body: Written at the proxy on the gateway and contained tiers: the stable prefix and the volatile selection, counted as steering_tokens and context_frame_tokens.

proposals.title: Proposals
proposals.lead: A proposal publishes when its Context PR passes every check and merges.
proposals.empty: Agents propose records through context/append, and a person proposes one with oxagen context propose. Each proposal waits here for a person to open its Context PR or dismiss it.
proposals.support: Support: {runs} runs, {agents} agents, {records} records, {evidence} evidence links

prs.title: Context PRs
prs.lead: Each Context PR runs the six checks that stella context validate runs.
prs.empty: No proposal on this page has a Context PR.

pr.heading: Context PR
pr.title: Context PR for {lineage}
pr.rejected: This proposal was dismissed. Its pull request is closed and its branch deleted.
pr.notOpened: No pull request is open for this proposal yet.
pr.modeUnread: read from the governance file when the pull request opens

modes.solo: solo: any workspace member merges, the author included
modes.team: team: an org Owner or Admin, or a workspace Owner, other than the author merges
modes.regulated: regulated: an org Owner or Admin other than the author merges, recorded as the accountable approver

names.constraint_effect: Constraint effect is require or forbid

onMerge.title: On merge
onMerge.publishes: Publish {path} as a record in force
onMerge.governance: Put the mode in {path} in force
onMerge.version: Take the workspace's promotion ledger from {current} entries to {next}
onMerge.promotion: Write the promotion event to the ledger and a steering_published audit event

memory.title: Memory records
memory.notBacked: the records on this memory branch and the memories each one cites. It needs list_memory_pr_records.

open.title: Open a Context PR
open.body: Oxagen opens a branch with the one record file, opens the pull request with the rationale and support, and runs the six checks one at a time. Merge is the publication.

dismiss.title: Dismiss this proposal
dismiss.body: A dismissed proposal steers nothing. An open Context PR for it is closed and its branch deleted.

merge.blocked: Merge is blocked until every check passes.

failure.orgRoleRequired: Your role in this organization or workspace does not allow this change. Nothing was changed.
failure.noPrincipal: This change needs a signed-in person. Nothing was changed.
failure.separationOfDuties: Under this governance mode the author does not merge their own proposal. Another reviewer merges it.
failure.proposalNotFound: This proposal is not in this workspace.
failure.proposalMoved: This proposal changed after the page loaded. Reload the page to see where it is.
failure.lineagePrOpen: Another pull request is already open for this lineage. Merge or close it first.
failure.governanceUnreadable: The workspace repository has a governance file that could not be read, so nothing was opened or merged.
failure.repositoryMissing: This workspace has no connected repository to open the pull request on.
failure.checksNotPassed: Merge is blocked until every check passes.
failure.approvalRequired: Merge needs an approval from a workspace member other than the author. An owner, or a member allowed to merge without review, can merge without one. Nothing was merged.
failure.approvalsNotHeadBound: Oxagen could not confirm which commit a reviewer approved on this GitLab project. Nothing was merged. Check that Reset approvals on push is on in the project's approval settings. The setting needs GitLab Premium, and the project access token must be able to read it. Oxagen also needs a GitLab version that reports when each approval was given.
failure.headMoved: The pull request changed after the checks ran. Run the checks again.
failure.baseMoved: The pull request no longer targets the production branch. Nothing was merged.
failure.githubRefused: GitHub refused the change. Nothing was published.
failure.gitlabRefused: GitLab refused the write. Nothing was published. Check that the project access token still has the api scope and the Developer role, then try again.
failure.gitlabCredentialRejected: GitLab no longer accepts the access token stored for this project. Nothing was changed. Connect the project again with a new token. If Oxagen created this steering project, an organization owner or admin must connect its group again with a new group access token.
failure.repositoryHostChanged: This pull request was opened on another host than the one the workspace's main repository is on now. Dismiss the proposal and propose it again.
failure.mergeTimeUnknown: The pull request merged and GitHub has not said when, so nothing was published. Merge again to publish it.
failure.mergedOutsideOxagen: Someone merged this pull request on the repository host after the checks ran. Oxagen publishes what the production branch holds, and this proposal shows the result once the sync finishes. The Steering freshness panel lists anything in the file it could not publish.
failure.refused: The change was refused: {code}. Nothing was changed.
failure.invalid: Write a reason before you dismiss the proposal.
failure.pendingApproval: The change is waiting for approval: {accessRequestId}.
failure.unavailable: The change could not be made: {code}. Nothing was changed.
failure.repositoryUnhealthy: The workspace repository's settings need repair, so Oxagen merges nothing until they are fixed. Runs keep the last published version.
failure.tooManyFiles: This steering PR changes too many files to merge. Nothing was merged.
failure.versionMismatch: The steering version this PR was checked against is not the one in force. Run the checks again.
failure.recordFileMissing: The record file is not on the branch at the checked commit. Nothing was changed.
failure.productionBranchMissing: The repository has no production branch to merge into. Nothing was merged.
failure.productionBranchMoving: The production branch kept moving while Oxagen was merging. Merge again.
failure.checksFailed: The production branch moved, and the checks failed after Oxagen brought the branch up to date. Fix the branch and run the checks again.
failure.toolNotRegistered: Oxagen has not registered this action yet.

deliveries.title: Steering delivery
deliveries.lead: The latest verified manifest for each recorded run in the last 7 days.
deliveries.empty: No steering manifests were recorded in this window. Older hosts may not report them.
deliveries.truncated: The window contains more than 2,000 manifests. These counts cover the newest 2,000.
deliveries.unreachedLead: These records were cut from every sampled manifest that considered them.
deliveries.noUnreached: Every candidate record appeared in at least one sampled manifest.
